beschreibung:
Contemplative Pilgrimage Site above the Inntal

The Wallfahrtskirche Locherboden rises visibly from afar on a wooded rocky knoll above the municipality of Mötz opposite Stams in the Oberinntal. The pilgrimage site dates back to a Marian miracle in the 18th century and rapidly developed into a cherished sanctuary.

Neo-Gothic Architecture and Panoramic Views

The present pilgrimage church was erected at the end of the 19th century in the neo-Gothic style. From the viewing platform in front of the church portal, an impressive panorama opens up across the central Inntal, the Mieminger Kette, and the Stubaier Alpen.
